dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The two of you really work very hard.

dialogues.speaker: Qinglian
dialogues.text: It's true, but right now, my body no longer requires that many herbs — what I need is my husband by my side.

dialogues.speaker: Qinglian
dialogues.text: Thanks for hearing me out. If you don't mind, let me give these to you.
